title: Families protest as police seal wedding venues in Sainik Farms after Delhi HC order | India News
description: Families protested against the sealing drive in Delhi’s Sainik Farms wedding venues on Monday and Tuesday after the Delhi Police acted on the orders of the Delhi high court directing civic authorities to act against banquet halls operating without valid permissions | India News
author: Jignasa Sinha
content:
Jignasa Sinha is a Special Correspondent at Hindustan Times in New Delhi. With more than six years of reporting experience, she covers crime and policing in the national capital. Her beats also include Delhi prisons, the Delhi Fire Services and Delhi courts, while she regularly reports on gender, labour and social justice. Over the course of her career, Jignasa has reported on major criminal investigations, international crime syndicates, high-profile cyber fraud cases, law-and-order developments, protests, disasters and public institutions. Her reporting combines breaking news with in-depth, long form, human interest stories that examine the human impact of public policy, policing and the criminal justice system. In addition to reporting for the newspaper, she contributes to the Hindustan Times website and app, and plays an active role in coordinating on-ground coverage of major developments and breaking news across Delhi. Before joining Hindustan Times, Jignasa worked at The Indian Express newspaper in New Delhi, where she spent five years covering crime, Delhi airport, courts and health. She began her journalism career as an intern at an AI magazine in Bengaluru while pursuing her postgraduate diploma in multimedia journalism at the Indian Institute of Journalism and New Media.
Families protest as police seal wedding venues in Sainik Farms after Delhi HC order
Families protested against the sealing drive in Delhi’s Sainik Farms wedding venues on Monday and Tuesday after the Delhi Police acted on the orders of the Delhi high court directing civic authorities to act against banquet halls operating without valid permissions
Families protested against the sealing drive in Delhi’s Sainik Farms wedding venues on Monday and Tuesday after the Delhi Police acted on the orders of the Delhi high court directing civic authorities to act against banquet halls operating without valid permissions.
Families allege the sealing drive led to last-minute cancellations and indefinite wedding postponements.
On November 19, the high court gave the directions after a petition by a local organisation complaining of illegal marriage venues and banquet halls, those without any fire safety clearance or statutory permissions from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD). The judge noted that for the safety of the people attending the functions at the venues, there should be an immediate suspension of events and commercial activities at the venues. The court also noted that these places can resume hosting events once they get necessary approvals.
Also Read: DDA razes Sainik Farms bungalow built on land marked for bio park
On Monday and Tuesday, as the Delhi Police started sealing the banquet halls without any prior notice, many families who had pre-booked these venues were left in disarray as they had no venue to host their function, lost all their money in deposits and other wedding expenses.
Senior police officials said they sealed seven venues by Tuesday afternoon.
Ravita Saha was supposed to get married on Tuesday but instead she was protesting outside the venue. Her father, Ram Lakhan Saha, said, “We had put in all our money and all of the arrangements were done. She was supposed to get married today. Now, what do I tell all my family members, in laws and the groom? My daughter is broken. Her wedding procession was ready but we had nowhere to go.”
Another woman, Aarti Singh, said, “My wedding is supposed to happen in ten days. We had to pay for everything three months back only. Now, on Tuesday, we found the venue being locked and sealed. We had no idea. My parents are trying but we are not able to find any other venue. The venue people also didn’t inform us. They are not even giving a refund. Also, its peak wedding season in Delhi. Where will I get married now?”
The families marched from the W lane in Sainik Farms where most of the venues had been sealed.
Indira Singh, 50, also participated in the protest as her daughter’s wedding has been postponed indefinitely.
“My daughter’s wedding is on Tuesday night. My daughter was in the salon. My husband and I were checking the decoration and caterers when we found the venue is being sealed and soon will be demolished. I paid for the wedding with all my savings six months back. My daughter is heartbroken and hasn’t stopped crying. We need justice. We have been humiliated in front of our family members. The wedding was supposed to happen in three hours. Can’t the government or Delhi Police give us some time?”
A senior police officer said, “The order was received over the weekend and work was started according to the high court’s order. We had to identify and seal all illegal banquet halls which can be a major safety issue for the locals and the people using the venue”
Also Read: HC pulls up Centre, Delhi for ‘passing the buck’ on Sainik Farms regularisation
Former Deoli MLA and Aap Aadmi Party (AAP) member Prakash Jarwal also joined in the protest.
“For the last 20 years, families from lower economic backgrounds in Raju Park, Tigri and Sangam Vihar have been hosting weddings at W-17 lane here. In Sangam Vihar, there’s no space or garden or wedding halls. They host weddings here as it’s also cheap. But now some fake organisation has come up and blackmailed these halls. When the establishments refused, they filed a petition. Now, HC has directed to seal venues and next hearing is not till December 10. Now, what will women and their families do? Today, a young woman was supposed to get married. She and her family are now suffering. I don’t understand this. In 2022, MCD had said open gardens don’t need permission. This is a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) trick to harass women.”
A statement from the BJP is awaited and the copy will be updated whenever it is received.

title: Rebel TMC MPs submit reply to Lok Sabha, defend exit from party | India News
description: A senior rebel TMC leader told HT that all 20 MPs have submitted their individual replies to the Lok Sabha secretariat. | India News
author: HT Correspondent
content:
Rebel TMC MPs submit reply to Lok Sabha, defend exit from party
A senior rebel TMC leader told HT that all 20 MPs have submitted their individual replies to the Lok Sabha secretariat.
Twenty rebel Trinamool Congress (TMC) MPs, who merged with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI) in June, on Tuesday submitted its response to the disqualification notices served by the Lok Sabha secretariat after taking four extensions.
A senior rebel TMC leader told HT that all 20 MPs have submitted their individual replies to the Lok Sabha secretariat. Drafted by lawyers, the replies are identical, an official said. In their reply, the rebel MPs defended their decision to quit the TMC and claimed that the move did not violate any parliamentary or constitutional provisions.
A month after the TMC was defeated in the West Bengal assembly elections, 20 of the party MPs met Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and submitted a letter seeking their merger with the NCPI. TMC’s floor leader Abhishek Banerjee had filed petitions seeking the expulsion of the rebel MPs on grounds of defection.
The TMC had argued that the Tenth schedule of the Constitution, only approves the merger of one political party with another, but it has no provision for a merger solely between two legislative units.
Defending their decision to leave the party, rebel TMC leader Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar argued that they followed all parliamentary and constitutional norms.
In the letters, the rebels highlighted that they constitute 20 of 28 TMC MPs, representing more than a two-thirds majority. They have maintained that their move does not attract disqualification under the anti-defection provisions.
The submission comes on the last day of the deadline set by the Lok Sabha Secretariat for the MPs to respond to notices issued by Birla on petitions seeking their disqualification under the anti-defection law.
“We have submitted our replies to the Lok Sabha Speaker and have defended our decision to join the NCPI,” Ghosh Dastidar said.
According to a senior functionary, the rebels also cited the recent mergers of six Shiv Sena UBT MPs joining the Sena led by Maharashtra deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde and the merger of six Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MPs with the BJP in the Rajya Sabha.
The development marks a significant step in the ongoing proceedings before the Lok Sabha Speaker, who will examine the replies before deciding on the disqualification petitions.
A section of the TMC believes that the issue will ultimately be settled in the Supreme Court, which is already hearing the Sena case and the AAP’s appeal.

title: Hotel’s master key no ground to absolve occupant of drug recovery: Supreme Court | India News
description: The mere possibility of access by the facility manager was not enough to discredit the prosecution’s case at the bail stage, the bench said. | India News
author: Utkarsh Anand
content:
Utkarsh Anand is the National Legal Editor at Hindustan Times, where he leads the newspaper's coverage of the Supreme Court, constitutional law, the judiciary and the Union law ministry. He joined Hindustan Times in 2020 after stints at Press Trust of India (PTI), The Indian Express and CNN-News18, and has over two decades of experience reporting on law, governance and public policy. His work has focussed on some of India's most consequential constitutional and legal developments, including the Supreme Court's judgments on Article 370, marriage equality, decriminalisation of homosexuality, the Babri Masjid dispute, electoral reforms and judicial appointments. He specialises in making complex legal proceedings and judgments accessible to readers while examining their wider social and political impact. Beyond daily reportage, Utkarsh has led investigative projects and enterprise reporting that have shaped public debate and prompted institutional responses. His work has received several journalism awards, including the Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Award. As National Legal Editor, he has also played a key role in expanding Hindustan Times' legal journalism footprint, mentoring reporters and strengthening coverage across platforms. A Chevening South Asia Journalism Programme Fellow, Utkarsh regularly writes analyses on the judiciary and constitutional issues, and his reporting is widely followed by lawyers, judges, policymakers, academics and readers seeking clarity on India's evolving legal landscape.
Hotel’s master key no ground to absolve occupant of drug recovery: Supreme Court
The mere possibility of access by the facility manager was not enough to discredit the prosecution’s case at the bail stage, the bench said.
A person occupying a hotel room or similar rented accommodation can be held responsible for narcotics or other contraband recovered from it, and the hotel management’s access to a duplicate key cannot, by itself, be grounds to exonerate the occupant, the Supreme Court has held.
Setting aside the bail granted to a man accused of possessing cocaine and MDMA in a rented accommodation in Goa, a bench of justices JB Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said accepting the reasoning adopted by the Bombay High Court would mean that no recovery made from a hotel room could ever be attributed to its occupant. Hotel managements routinely retain duplicate keys and may enter rooms for cleaning and other purposes, the bench said.
“If such a reasoning is accepted, then any recovery made from a hotel or a rental facility cannot be pinned on the person occupying the room,” the bench said in an order last week. The mere possibility of access by the facility manager was not enough to discredit the prosecution’s case at the bail stage, it added.
The court was hearing an appeal by the Goa government against the high court’s decision to grant bail to the man, who was booked under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act after 50.03 grams of cocaine and 15.04 grams of MDMA (ecstasy) were allegedly recovered from an Airbnb property in Vagator in January, 2025.
The high court had accepted the argument that the facility manager had unhindered access to the room and could have planted the contraband before the police raid. The accused had also claimed that he was picked up from the basement of the property, detained for two days and then taken to the room, where the drugs were planted. He further alleged that he was tortured in police custody and that the police had inflicted a burn injury on his hand.
Rejecting these contentions, the Supreme Court said the material before it, including the counter-affidavit filed by the accused himself, prima facie undermined his defence and supported the prosecution’s account of the raid and recovery.
The bench noted that the first information report and search warrant showed that the raiding officer had received reliable information on January 22, 2025, about narcotics activity allegedly being carried out by the accused from his room. The officer had informed his superior and obtained the requisite permission to conduct the search, besides securing the seal required for the seizure of contraband.
The search was conducted in the presence of independent panch witnesses, an industries inspector and a lower division clerk, as well as the facility manager. The police also video-recorded the search and seizure, the court noted.
On the question of who occupied the premises, the court examined the leave and licence agreement between the property owner and the facility manager, which permitted the manager to use the premises commercially and rent them out on a daily basis.
The prosecution’s case, supported by the manager’s statement, was that the premises had been rented out to the accused from January 17 to January 26, 2025, the period during which the arrest and recovery took place. The court noted that the recovery was made while the commercial licence was in force and within the period for which the premises were allegedly let out to the accused.
Finding no reason to sustain the high court’s order, the bench set it aside and directed the accused to surrender within three weeks. If he does not, he will be arrested and produced before the jurisdictional court to be taken into judicial custody, subject to any order that court may pass on police custody.

title: Advisory group to be set up for startups, MSMEs in telecom sector: Scindia | India News
description: New Delhi: The government will set up an advisory group for startups and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the telecom sector to help Indian companies develop and commercialise telecom products, Union communications minister Jyotiraditya M Scindia said on Tuesday | India News
author: HT Correspondent
content:
Advisory group to be set up for startups, MSMEs in telecom sector: Scindia
New Delhi: The government will set up an advisory group for startups and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the telecom sector to help Indian companies develop and commercialise telecom products, Union communications minister Jyotiraditya M Scindia said on Tuesday
New Delhi: The government will set up an advisory group for startups and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the telecom sector to help Indian companies develop and commercialise telecom products, Union communications minister Jyotiraditya M Scindia said on Tuesday.
Scindia announced the group at the Telecom Startups and MSME Conclave at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. He said the panel would discuss issues raised by entrepreneurs at the event and help the government decide how it could support Indian companies building telecom products.
Startups and MSMEs at the conclave sought government support for trials and commercialisation of their technology, according to news agency PTI.
“I have announced the setting up of an advisory group for our startups and our MSMEs... All of these will be discussed in the advisory group, and we will chart our path forward where the government steps in and acts as a facilitator,” Scindia said.
The aim, he said, was “to ensure that Indian entrepreneurs proliferate on the product side and India moves from a consumer of technology to a creator and a supplier of technology for the world.”
The minister did not provide details of the group’s members, mandate or timeline.
HT reached out to the ministry for details but did not immediately receive a response.
Telecom conclave
Scindia described the conclave as “an exhilarating experience” that showcased “India’s entrepreneurial capability in the telecom technology space”. He said India “has attracted all the global technology majors to set up centres in India”.
He also positioned the announcement as part of a wider effort to make India a centre for telecom research and development.
“India today is the place for innovation, for R&D, and for the emergence of new technology under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s vision,” he said, describing the telecom sector as “probably the largest opportunity in India across the world.”
Scindia cited figures to highlight the scale of India’s telecom and connectivity network. He said the country has more than a billion internet and broadband connections and 133 crore mobile connections. He said 5G had been rolled out “at the fastest level and pace globally” and now has 500 million customers.
He also referred to the Bharat 6G Alliance, saying India is “setting the pace for standard-setting for 6G”.
“That platform and that foundation for telecom technologies to proliferate is today very, very strong and sound in India,” Scindia said.

title: Centre eyes custom duty tweaks on key inputs | India News
description: New Delhi: The government may undertake a comprehensive review of customs duties on hundreds of items, mainly inputs and intermediate goods, to rein in inflation, boost manufacturing and make exports competitive amid geopolitical turbulence that has disrupted global supply chains, persons aware of the matter said | India News
author: Rajeev Jayaswal
content:
Rajeev Jayaswal is a senior journalist, author and communication strategist with over three decades of experience covering India's economy, energy, trade and public policy. He is Senior Editor at Hindustan Times and author of The Lobbyists, recognised for insightful reporting, in-depth analysis and policy-focused journalism.
Centre eyes custom duty tweaks on key inputs
New Delhi: The government may undertake a comprehensive review of customs duties on hundreds of items, mainly inputs and intermediate goods, to rein in inflation, boost manufacturing and make exports competitive amid geopolitical turbulence that has disrupted global supply chains, persons aware of the matter said
New Delhi: The government may undertake a comprehensive review of customs duties on hundreds of items, mainly inputs and intermediate goods, to rein in inflation, boost manufacturing and make exports competitive amid geopolitical turbulence that has disrupted global supply chains, persons aware of the matter said.
Rising inflation is an immediate concern, and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is expected to tighten monetary policy by raising its policy rate in early December, they said, asking not to be named. The government could complement the RBI’s move by tweaking import duties on essential commodities and industrial inputs such as edible oil, pulses, raw cotton, graphite electrodes, chemicals, metals and energy products, they said.
According to the latest government data, inflation as measured by the wholesale price index (WPI) jumped to 12.29% in October, while retail inflation, measured by the annual change in the consumer price index (CPI), breached the RBI’s upper tolerance limit of 6% in the month. The RBI’s bulletin on October 23 cited “renewed geopolitical frictions in West Asia and supply chain disruptions” that have amplified inflationary pressures.
Drawing on industry recommendations received through various ministries and departments, the government is compiling an exhaustive list of items on which changes in customs duty have been proposed. The changes would either lower input costs or protect domestic industry by raising import duties. A final call will be taken in the forthcoming Union budget after a thorough examination, they said.
“Depending on sector-specific urgency, the government may tweak customs duties on certain items even before the budget,” one of the persons said. A proposal to extend the duty exemption on raw cotton beyond December 31, for instance, is under consideration, he added.
The government exempted cotton imports from customs duty for five months from June 1 to ensure the domestic textile industry had adequate supplies of the raw material at competitive rates. On October 31, it extended the exemption by two months.
The government is also reviewing customs duty concessions extended to nearly 1,200 special economic zones (SEZs) manufacturing units for goods they sell in the domestic tariff area (DTA). The concessions were meant to improve capacity utilisation at SEZ units hit by global trade disruptions, a second person said. Under the SEZ Act, goods cleared from an SEZ into the DTA are treated as imports into India and attract the applicable customs duties.
The relief was announced as a one-time measure and will end on March 31, 2027. But some industry segments want it extended for them because the global geopolitical situation has not yet normalised, he said.
The concessions cover nearly 500 products made from minerals, chemicals, plastics and rubber, leather and footwear, textiles, stone, ceramic and glassware, machinery and electrical equipment, aircraft and transport equipment, optical, medical and scientific instruments, and arms and ammunition. They do not apply to sectors such as agriculture, marine and processed food products, tobacco, marble and granite, gems and jewellery, toys and petroleum.

Delhi plans 2 new biomedical waste plants at ₹41 cr amid pollution violation concerns
The DPCC has already initiated the process of setting up the two facilities by inviting bids for the project
Delhi is planning a major overhaul of its biomedical waste management system, with two new common biomedical waste treatment and disposal facilities proposed across the national Capital at an estimated cost of ₹41 crore.
The move comes amid concerns over environmental violations at the two existing facilities, one of which continued to emit thick black smoke and failed to properly segregate biomedical waste despite repeated inspections by the Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC).
Project details
The two proposed facilities will cater to different geographical zones of the city. The first, estimated to cost ₹20 crore, will cover East, North-East, Old Delhi and Central districts, while the second, with an estimated cost of ₹21 crore, will serve West, South-West and Outer North districts.
The DPCC has already initiated the process of setting up the two facilities by inviting bids for the project. According to the project report, the facility will be developed on a Built, Own and Operate (BOO) basis.
Also Read: Pollution crackdown: DPCC inspects 3K sites, sends closure notice to 103
The company deployed for the project will execute collection, transportation, reception, storage, treatment and final disposal of biomedical waste generated in the designated districts.
The proposed expansion assumes significance as Delhi currently relies on two operational common biomedical waste treatment facilities, with a combined installed capacity of 62.8 tonnes per day. These facilities process biomedical waste generated by hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and other healthcare establishments that do not have their own treatment infrastructure.
Environmental Compliance Under Scrutiny
However, their environmental compliance has come under scrutiny. In a status report submitted to the National Green Tribunal (NGT), the DPCC flagged several violations at Biotic Waste Solutions (BWS) in Jahangirpuri and SMS Water Grace at the Delhi Jal Board’s Nilothi sewage treatment plant.
Also Read: DPCC asks seven agencies to submit daily pollution action reports by 5pm
While Biotic Waste Solutions rectified some deficiencies identified during the initial inspection, SMS Water Grace continued to violate three significant parameters during a follow-up inspection in July. These included emissions of thick black smoke from its incinerator, mixing of different categories of biomedical waste at the unloading area and inadequate effluent treatment. The facility was subsequently issued another show-cause notice in September, proposing closure and withdrawal of its authorisation.

author: Jignasa Sinha
content:
Jignasa Sinha is a Special Correspondent at Hindustan Times in New Delhi. With more than six years of reporting experience, she covers crime and policing in the national capital. Cops flee, doors shut as man goes on stabbing spree at Delhi police station; CCTV captures horror
The footage shows cops fleeing and trying to overpower Mohd Nabeel as he stabbed five personnel inside Jama Masjid police station before injuring four more.
As a 30-year-old man went on a stabbing spree at the Jama Masjid police station on Monday, CCTV footage of the incident seen by HT captured the pandemonium – several cops running for cover as the knife-wielding attacker walked around the police station, others trying to shut doors to lock him inside, and a handful attempting to subdue him with sticks, all in vain. Throughout, the video shows, the knifeman continuously swung his weapon, stabbing anyone within reach.
The shocking incident took place on Monday when the man, identified by police as Mohd Nabeel, wounded nine police officers – five at the police station and four during an encounter where he was shot six times. He then stole a two-wheeler at knifepoint but was caught two hours later. Police fired eight rounds at him, six of which hit his legs. They said they fired after he injured four more personnel at Chitli Qabar.
According to police officers, Nabeel was summoned to the police station after his mother and sister complained about his aggressive behaviour. He was aggressive from the moment he arrived and, without provocation, attacked the officer he thought had phoned him.
Deep Dive
Nabeel has been ordered to judicial custody by court. He will lodged in custody after treatment.
On Tuesday, HT saw parts of the footage showing the accused entering the police station and heading straight towards two personnel, including a female official sitting on chairs. The footage shows the man apparently shouting.
“When the female official identified herself and the sub-inspector next to her, the man got angry and charged at sub-inspector Aravind,” a senior officer part of the investigation said.
The footage shows the man slashing Aravind’s neck and face. As soon as he attacked the SI, the female official screamed while Nabeel’s mother and sister – sitting in the same room – ducked under a desk. A second officer then arrived and tried to confront Nabeel. The SI is stabbed in his neck and arm and and he goes to hide himself in a corner.
By this time, panic broke out inside the police station.
At least three personnel were seen running for cover. Nabeel then moved towards a room and tried to force his way inside, but personnel shut the door. He then walked near the lock-up area, where panicked cops tried to pick up weapons.
Three cops attacked him with sticks in an attempt to subdue him, but he slashed away, stabbing two of them. One was identified as head-constable Harender, who suffered injuries on his face, neck, and chest.
Another policeman, a head-constable in his 50s, tried to shut the main door but Nabeel pushed it and kicked it, causing him to fall. Another policeman followed with a stick, but Nabeel stabbed the fifth cop. He walks out of the station in front of an armed sentry.
The incident took place around 2:30 pm. Nabeel then went outside and snatched a two-wheeler at knifepoint.
“It all happened in five minutes. Even when this was happening, his mother and sister were inside the station. They then left. Since they had only interacted with SI Ajay, who was also injured, nobody knew who Nabeel was and why he had come. Amid the panic, all five policemen were rushed to a nearby hospital. After 15-20 minutes, Ajay said two women had come to complain about Nabeel. We then traced the women, took details and photos, and started a probe,” a senior officer said.
Also read: Delhi man stabs 9 cops at police station; held after shoot-out
DCP (Central) Rohit Rajbir Singh said the team managed to catch him within two hours. “There was no time to scan footage and analyse technical information. We had seen his photo and forwarded it to informers and public persons. People on the street outside the station helped trace the route.”
DCP Singh said the injured – SI Ajay, SI Aravind, and HC Harender – suffered 2-3-inch-deep injuries on their faces, neck, chest, and arms. “They will undergo plastic surgery as well as critical surgery for damaged arteries. We are also looking into whether this was avoidable. One major issue was that only a few people were inside because most of the staff was busy with VIP movements in the city.”
Investigators said Nabeel is still under observation. “He suffered heavy blood loss. We are yet to question him. He was not employed and would sometimes sit at his father’s shop. We also want to check his internet history. His family complained about his behaviour,” a second officer said.
Three FIRs have been lodged against him for attempted murder and robbery. At Kala Mahal, where Nabeel’s family lives, his parents and siblings locked their home on Tuesday.

उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम को झटका… सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने जमानत देने किया इनकार, पुलिस का पक्ष सुनेगी बेंच
शरजील इमाम और उमर खालिद को सुप्रीम कोर्ट से झटका लगा है. अदालत ने उन्हें अंतरिम जमानत देने से इनकार कर दिया. बेंच ने कहा कि वह इस मामले पर पहले दिल्ली पुलिस का पक्ष सुनना चाहेगी.
देश की शीर्ष अदालत ने दिल्ली दंगों से जुड़ा बड़ी साजिश के मामले में आज उमर खालिद और शरजील इमाम की जमानत याचिका पर सुनवाई की. सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने खालिद और इमाम दोनों को ही जमानत देने से इनकार कर दिया. चीफ जस्टिस सूर्यकांत की अध्यक्षता वाली बेंच मामले की सुनवाई कर रही थी.
अदालत ने कहा कि वह अंतरिम जमानत की मांग पर विचार करने से पहले पुलिस का पक्ष सुनना चाहेगी. इस संबंध में कोर्ट ने दिल्ली पुलिस को नोटिस भी जारी किया है.
शरजील इमाम और उमर खालिद की तरफ से वरिष्ठ वकील कपिल सिब्बल पेश हुए. उन्होंने दोनों के लिए अंतरिम जमानत मांगने की अर्जी पर विचार करने के लिए कहा. इस पर CJI सूर्य कांत ने कहा – आज नहीं.

title: पहले परिवार में सेंध, अब दावेदारी वाली सीट पर प्रत्याशी… इमरान के बड़बोलेपन का अखिलेश ऐसे दे रहे...
description: सहारनपुर में सपा-कांग्रेस के बीच सीटों को लेकर टकराव बढ़ गया है. सपा ने बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात पर प्रत्याशी घोषित किए, जबकि इमरान मसूद ने ऐलान कर दिया कि वह सातों सीट पर प्रत्याशी उतारेंगे.
author: विकास कपिल
content:
पहले परिवार में सेंध, अब दावेदारी वाली सीट पर प्रत्याशी… इमरान के बड़बोलेपन का अखिलेश ऐसे दे रहे जवाब?
सहारनपुर में सपा-कांग्रेस के बीच सीटों को लेकर टकराव बढ़ गया है. सपा ने बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात पर प्रत्याशी घोषित किए, जबकि इमरान मसूद ने ऐलान कर दिया कि वह सातों सीट पर प्रत्याशी उतारेंगे.
यूपी में विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले समाजवादी पार्टी (सपा) और कांग्रेस गठबंधन की सीटों को लेकर खींचतान अब जिलों तक पहुंचने लगी है. सहारनपुर में सीटों के बंटवारे को लेकर दोनों दलों के बीच सियासी तल्खी बढ़ती दिख रही है. सपा ने बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात सीट पर अपने प्रत्याशी घोषित कर दिए हैं, जबकि कांग्रेस इन दोनों सीटों पर भी दावेदारी कर रही थी.
कांग्रेस सांसद इमरान मसूद सहारनपुर की सात सीटों पर कांग्रेस की हिस्सेदारी चाहते हैं, लेकिन सपा अपनी जीती हुई सीटें छोड़ने के मूड में नहीं है. इधर मसूद परिवार से जुड़े शायान मसूद की सपा में एंट्री ने भी जिले की सियासत में नए समीकरण पैदा कर दिए हैं. अब सवाल है कि क्या सहारनपुर में सीटों की लड़ाई सपा-कांग्रेस गठबंधन के लिए मुश्किल खड़ी करेगी? क्या इमरान मसूद की दावेदारी को अखिलेश यादव ने अपने फैसले से चुनौती दी है?
सहारनपुर में खींचतान
सपा ने बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात विधानसभा सीट पर अपने प्रत्याशी घोषित कर दिए हैं. बेहट से उमर अली खान और सहारनपुर देहात से आशु मलिक को टिकट दिया गया है. दोनों सीटों पर समाजवादी पार्टी के मौजूदा विधायक हैं और 2022 के विधानसभा चुनाव में पार्टी ने इन सीटों पर जीत दर्ज की थी. कांग्रेस इन दोनों सीटों के अलावा गंगोह, नकुड़ और रामपुर मनिहारन सीट पर भी हिस्सेदारी चाहती है.
कांग्रेस ने सातों पर लड़ने के दिए संकेत
सहारनपुर जिले में विधानसभा की कुल सात सीटें हैं. कांग्रेस इन सात सीटों में से पांच पर अपनी हिस्सेदारी चाहती है. इनमें बेहट, सहारनपुर देहात, गंगोह, नकुड़ और रामपुर मनिहारन सीट शामिल हैं, लेकिन सपा ने बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात पर अपने प्रत्याशी घोषित करके यह संकेत दिया है कि वह अपनी जीती हुई सीटों को गठबंधन के नाम पर आसानी से छोड़ने को तैयार नहीं है. कांग्रेस की तरफ से भी सियासी दबाव बढ़ाया जा रहा है. पार्टी ने जिले की सभी सात सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ने का संकेत देकर गठबंधन की बातचीत के बीच अपनी स्थिति मजबूत करने की कोशिश की है.
पहले दामाद को तोड़ा, अब दावेदारी वाली सीट पर प्रत्याशी
अखिलेश यादव ने सहारनपुर में इमरान मसूद को जवाब देने के लिए सीधे बयानबाजी का रास्ता नहीं चुना, बल्कि सियासी चालों से दबाव बनाने की कोशिश की. पहले इमरान मसूद के दामाद शायान मसूद को कांग्रेस से तोड़कर सपा में शामिल कराया. शायान मसूद पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री काजी रशीद मसूद के पौत्र हैं और 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में अपने ससुर इमरान मसूद के लिए प्रचार भी कर चुके थे. लेकिन अब ससुर और दामाद की राजनीतिक राहें अलग हो चुकी हैं.
20 अगस्त को लखनऊ में अखिलेश यादव ने शायान मसूद और उनके पिता शाजान मसूद को समाजवादी पार्टी में शामिल कराया. शायान पहले कांग्रेस में थे और सपा सरकार में दर्जा प्राप्त राज्यमंत्री भी रह चुके हैं. उनके सपा में आने को सहारनपुर में कांग्रेस और इमरान मसूद के लिए राजनीतिक झटका माना गया. शायान ने पार्टी बदलने के बाद इमरान मसूद से वैचारिक मतभेद भी खुलकर जाहिर किए. उन्होंने कहा कि बीजेपी को हराना है तो बीजेपी के खिलाफ बोलना होगा, लेकिन इमरान मसूद अखिलेश यादव पर हमला कर रहे हैं. शायान ने अखिलेश यादव को बीजेपी को हराने का सबसे प्रभावी विकल्प बताया.
अखिलेश के फैसले से इमरान मसूद की दावेदारी को झटका?
सपा की ओर से बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात सीट पर प्रत्याशी घोषित किए जाने के बाद इमरान मसूद ने नाराजगी जताई है. उन्होंने सीटों पर बातचीत जारी रहने के बीच प्रत्याशी घोषित किए जाने पर सवाल उठाए. इमरान मसूद ने कहा कि कांग्रेस कोई भीख मांगने वाली पार्टी नहीं है. उन्होंने गठबंधन की गंभीरता पर सवाल उठाते हुए कहा कि पहले तय होना चाहिए कि बीजेपी से लड़ना है या कांग्रेस से. इमरान मसूद के भतीजे हमजा नोमान मसूद ने भी सपा की प्रत्याशी घोषणा पर तीखी प्रतिक्रिया दी. उन्होंने कहा कि कांग्रेस किसी दबाव में नहीं आएगी और सहारनपुर की सातों सीटों पर मजबूती से चुनाव लड़ सकती है.
सपा अपनी जीती सीटें कांग्रेस को क्यों दे?
इस बीच समाजवादी पार्टी के नेताओं का तर्क है कि बेहट और सहारनपुर देहात जैसी सीटों पर पार्टी के मौजूदा विधायक हैं. 2022 में दोनों सीटों पर सपा ने जीत दर्ज की थी. संगठनात्मक स्तर पर भी पार्टी इन सीटों पर मजबूत स्थिति में होने का दावा करती है. ऐसे में गठबंधन के नाम पर अपनी जीती हुई सीटें कांग्रेस को देने का सवाल क्यों उठे? सपा की रणनीति सीटों पर अपने चुनावी प्रदर्शन, संगठन की मजबूती और प्रत्याशी की जीतने की क्षमता के आधार पर दावेदारी तय करने की बताई जा रही है. पार्टी के भीतर यह तर्क भी दिया जा रहा है कि उत्तर प्रदेश में कांग्रेस की मौजूदा राजनीतिक हैसियत ऐसी नहीं है कि वह सीटों के मामले में सपा पर दबाव बना सके.
गठबंधन बना तो बीजेपी के सामने चुनौती, टूटा तो वोटों का बिखराव
सहारनपुर की सात विधानसभा सीटों पर सपा-कांग्रेस गठबंधन का चुनावी गणित काफी अहम है. दोनों दल एक साथ चुनाव लड़ते हैं तो उनके वोटों का समन्वय और संगठनात्मक ताकत बीजेपी के सामने चुनौती खड़ी कर सकती है. मुस्लिम मतदाताओं, ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के जातीय समीकरण और स्थानीय प्रत्याशियों की लोकप्रियता चुनावी परिणाम को प्रभावित करने वाले कारक हो सकते हैं, लेकिन अगर सीटों के बंटवारे पर सहमति नहीं बनी और दोनों दल अलग-अलग चुनाव मैदान में उतरते हैं तो उनके वोटों का बिखराव भी हो सकता है. ऐसी स्थिति में बीजेपी को चुनावी समीकरणों में फायदा मिलने की संभावना बन सकती है.

title: टीचर ने अश्लील मैसेज भेजकर कहा अकेले में मिलो… विरोध करने पर दी नंबर काटने की धमकी
description: गुना में शिक्षक पर 12वीं की छात्रा को आपत्तिजनक व्हाट्सएप संदेश भेजने और अकेले मिलने का दबाव बनाने का आरोप लगा है. छात्रा की शिकायत पर मामला दर्ज किया गया है.
author: प्रमोद पंत
content:
टीचर ने अश्लील मैसेज भेजकर कहा अकेले में मिलो… विरोध करने पर दी नंबर काटने की धमकी
गुना में शिक्षक पर 12वीं की छात्रा को आपत्तिजनक व्हाट्सएप संदेश भेजने और अकेले मिलने का दबाव बनाने का आरोप लगा है. छात्रा की शिकायत पर मामला दर्ज किया गया है.
गुना जिले में शिक्षा के मंदिर में गुरु-शिष्य के रिश्ते को शर्मसार करने वाला मामला सामने आया है. गुना के पीएमश्री कन्या उच्चतर माध्यमिक विद्यालय कैंट में पदस्थ एक शिक्षक पर 12वीं की छात्रा को व्हाट्सएप पर आपत्तिजनक संदेश भेजने, अकेले मिलने का दबाव बनाने और परीक्षा में नंबर काटने की धमकी देने के गंभीर आरोप लगे हैं. मामले में छात्रा की शिकायत और सामने आई व्हाट्सएप चैट के आधार पर पुलिस ने आरोपी शिक्षक नरेंद्र कुशवाह के खिलाफ पॉक्सो एक्ट सहित संबंधित धाराओं में मामला दर्ज कर उसे हिरासत में लिया है.
छात्रा की शिकायत के मुताबिक, शिक्षक बीते कुछ समय से उसे लगातार व्हाट्सएप पर संदेश भेज रहा था. छात्रा को अकेले मिलने और बाहर घूमने के लिए दबाव बनाया जा रहा था. चैट में शिक्षक द्वारा कथित तौर पर कहा गया कि वह रात 12 बजे सोया करे और उसके साथ चले. इसके अलावा बर्थडे का बहाना बनाकर मिलने आने और शाम 8 बजे तक फ्री कर देने जैसी बातें भी सामने आई हैं.
नंबर काटने की धमकी से छात्रा परेशान
आरोप है कि जब छात्रा ने शिक्षक की बातों का विरोध किया, तो उसने परीक्षा में कम अंक देने और पढ़ाई में नुकसान पहुंचाने की धमकी दी. शिक्षक कथित तौर पर अपने पद और नंबर देने के अधिकार का हवाला देकर छात्रा पर दबाव बना रहा था. लगातार मिल रही धमकियों से छात्रा मानसिक तनाव में आ गई और उसकी पढ़ाई भी प्रभावित होने लगी. डर और दबाव के बीच छात्रा ने आखिरकार अपनी मां को पूरे मामले की जानकारी दी.
इसके बाद मां और बेटी ने जिला शिक्षा अधिकारी, स्कूल प्रिंसिपल , पुलिस अधीक्षक और थाना प्रभारी को शिकायत सौंपकर कार्रवाई की मांग की. छात्रा ने अपनी सुरक्षा को लेकर भी चिंता जताई है. शिकायत में अन्य छात्राओं के साथ भी इसी तरह की हरकतें किए जाने का आरोप लगाया गया है. हालांकि, इन आरोपों की स्वतंत्र पुष्टि होना बाकी है. शिकायत में एक और गंभीर आरोप लगाया गया है.
स्कूल में पर्दे के पीछे बनाई थी अलग जगह!
छात्रा के मुताबिक, शिक्षक ने स्कूल परिसर में पर्दे की आड़ में एक जगह बना रखी थी और वहां बैठकर बातचीत करने के लिए दबाव बनाता था. मामले के सामने आने के बाद स्कूल में चर्चा तेज हो गई. अखिल भारतीय विद्यार्थी परिषद ने भी प्रिसिंपल को ज्ञापन सौंपकर आरोपी शिक्षक के खिलाफ सख्त कार्रवाई की मांग की है. स्कूल के प्रिंसिपल संजय कुमार जैन ने बताया कि 12वीं की छात्रा अपनी मां के साथ शिकायत लेकर आई थी.
छात्रा ने बाल दिवस के बाद से शिक्षक द्वारा चैट किए जाने की बात कही और संबंधित चैट की कॉपी भी दी है. शिकायत को जांच के लिए जिला शिक्षा अधिकारी के पास भेज दिया गया है. वहीं पुलिस ने शिकायत और व्हाट्सएप चैट के आधार पर आरोपी शिक्षक के खिलाफ पॉक्सो एक्ट एवं अन्य संबंधित धाराओं में मामला दर्ज कर आगे की कार्रवाई शुरू कर दी है.

title: कार्तिक पूर्णिमा पर दिखा आस्था का महासंगम, 30 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने लगाई डुबकी
description: यूपी के प्रमुख तीर्थस्थलों में काशी से अयोध्या तक कल सनातन आस्था की भव्य झलक दिखी. प्रयागराज में सर्वाधिक 10 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने गंगा स्नान किया, वहीं काशी में 8 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने पवित्र स्नान किया.
author: TV9 Bharatvarsh
content:
कार्तिक पूर्णिमा पर दिखा आस्था का महासंगम, 30 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने लगाई डुबकी
यूपी के प्रमुख तीर्थस्थलों में काशी से अयोध्या तक कल सनातन आस्था की भव्य झलक दिखी. प्रयागराज में सर्वाधिक 10 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने गंगा स्नान किया, वहीं काशी में 8 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने पवित्र स्नान किया.
उत्तर प्रदेश की योगी सरकार में तीर्थस्थलों के विकास और धार्मिक पर्यटन को विशेष प्रोत्साहन मिल रहा है. कार्तिक पूर्णिमा पर मंगलवार को प्रदेश के प्रमुख तीर्थों में आस्था का महासंगम देखने को मिला. काशी से अयोध्या और प्रयागराज से नैमिषारण्य तक करीब 30 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने पवित्र स्नान किया. भोर से ही गंगा और सरयू के घाटों पर श्रद्धालुओं की भीड़ उमड़ने लगी. हर-हर गंगे और जय श्रीराम के उद्घोष के बीच श्रद्धालुओं ने स्नान, पूजा-अर्चना और दान-पुण्य किया. घाटों पर उमड़ा जनसैलाब सनातन संस्कृति और धार्मिक परंपराओं के प्रति लोगों की गहरी आस्था का साक्षी बना.
कार्तिक पूर्णिमा पर तीर्थराज प्रयागराज में सर्वाधिक करीब 10 लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने गंगा में डुबकी लगाई. भोर से ही घाटों पर स्नान का सिलसिला शुरू हो गया. श्रद्धालुओं ने पूजा-अर्चना और दान-पुण्य कर मंगलकामना की. वहीं, धर्मनगरी काशी में करीब आठ लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने गंगा स्नान किया. भगवान सूर्य को अर्घ्य देने के साथ घाटों पर धार्मिक अनुष्ठान हुए. देव दीपावली की परंपरा से जुड़ी काशी में दिनभर उत्सव जैसा वातावरण रहा.
अयोध्या में पांच लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने किया सरयू स्नान
रामनगरी अयोध्या में करीब पांच लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने सरयू में आस्था की डुबकी लगाई. भोर से ही सरयू घाटों पर श्रद्धालुओं का पहुंचना शुरू हो गया था. स्नान के बाद श्रद्धालुओं ने मंदिरों में दर्शन-पूजन किया. जय श्रीराम के उद्घोष से रामनगरी का वातावरण भक्तिमय बना रहा.
गढ़मुक्तेश्वर में 3 लाख, डलमऊ-नैमिषारण्य में 2-2 लाख ने किया स्नान
हापुड़ के गढ़मुक्तेश्वर में करीब तीन लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने गंगा में पवित्र स्नान किया. वहीं, रायबरेली के डलमऊ में करीब दो लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने गंगा स्नान कर पूजा-अर्चना और दान-पुण्य किया. सीतापुर के पौराणिक तीर्थ नैमिषारण्य में भी करीब दो लाख श्रद्धालुओं ने पवित्र स्नान और धार्मिक अनुष्ठान किए. सभी तीर्थस्थलों पर सुबह से श्रद्धालुओं की आवाजाही बनी रही.

title: सऊदी अरब पर हमले से भारत चिंतित, घायल भारतीयों की मदद में जुटा दूतावास
description: सऊदी अरब की राजधानी रियाद में फाइनेंशियल डिस्ट्रिक्ट टावर पर हुए हमले में दो भारतीय घायल हो गए. भारत ने हमले की कड़ी निंदा करते हुए सऊदी अरब के साथ एकजुटता जताई है.
author: अंकिता पाण्डेय
content:
सऊदी अरब पर हमले से भारत चिंतित, घायल भारतीयों की मदद में जुटा दूतावास
सऊदी अरब की राजधानी रियाद में फाइनेंशियल डिस्ट्रिक्ट टावर पर हुए हमले में दो भारतीय घायल हो गए. भारत ने हमले की कड़ी निंदा करते हुए सऊदी अरब के साथ एकजुटता जताई है.
सऊदी अरब की राजधानी रियाद में हुए हमले ने एक बार फिर पश्चिम एशिया में बढ़ते तनाव को लेकर चिंता बढ़ा दी है. 24 नवंबर को रियाद के फाइनेंशियल डिस्ट्रिक्ट स्थित एक टावर को निशाना बनाया गया. इस हमले में दो भारतीय नागरिक घायल हुए हैं. घटना के बाद भारत सरकार ने हमले की कड़ी निंदा करते हुए सऊदी अरब के प्रति एकजुटता जताई है. भारत ने कहा कि इस तरह के हमले न केवल आम नागरिकों की जान को खतरे में डालते हैं, बल्कि क्षेत्र की शांति और स्थिरता को भी प्रभावित करते हैं.
विदेश मंत्रालय ने 25 नवंबर को जारी बयान में हमले तुरंत रोकने की अपील की है. वहीं, रियाद स्थित भारतीय दूतावास घायलों और उनके परिवारों की हर संभव मदद कर रहा है. भारत ने अपने आधिकारिक बयान में सऊदी अरब के नागरिक, आर्थिक और ऊर्जा से जुड़े बुनियादी ढांचे पर लगातार हो रहे हमलों की निंदा की है. रियाद का फाइनेंशियल डिस्ट्रिक्ट देश के प्रमुख आर्थिक और कारोबारी क्षेत्रों में शामिल है.
हमले में दो भारतीय नागरिक घायल
ऐसे महत्वपूर्ण स्थान को निशाना बनाए जाने से लोगों की सुरक्षा के साथ आर्थिक गतिविधियों पर भी खतरा पैदा होता है. भारत ने इसे क्षेत्रीय शांति और स्थिरता के लिए गंभीर चुनौती बताया है. इस हमले में दो भारतीय नागरिकों के घायल होने की जानकारी सामने आई है. घटना के बाद रियाद स्थित भारतीय दूतावास ने घायलों और उनके परिवारों से संपर्क कर हर संभव सहायता उपलब्ध कराने की बात कही है.
भारत ने सऊदी की संप्रभुता पर जताई चिंता
भारत सरकार ने विदेश में रह रहे अपने नागरिकों की सुरक्षा को प्राथमिकता बताया है. हालांकि, आधिकारिक बयान में घायलों की पहचान और उनकी चोटों की गंभीरता के बारे में जानकारी नहीं दी गई है. भारत ने कहा कि इस तरह के हमले आम नागरिकों की जिंदगी को खतरे में डालते हैं और सऊदी अरब की संप्रभुता का उल्लंघन करते हैं. साथ ही ये पूरे क्षेत्र की सुरक्षा और स्थिरता को कमजोर करते हैं. भारत ने सभी पक्षों से ऐसे हमलों को तुरंत रोकने की अपील की है.
भारत का सऊदी को समर्थन, शांति की अपील
बयान में नागरिकों, आर्थिक संस्थानों और ऊर्जा से जुड़े ठिकानों को निशाना बनाने पर भी चिंता जताई गई है. भारत ने सऊदी अरब की सरकार और वहां के लोगों के प्रति अपनी एकजुटता दोहराई है. साथ ही सऊदी अरब की संप्रभुता, क्षेत्रीय अखंडता और नागरिकों की सुरक्षा के प्रयासों का समर्थन किया है. भारत ने उम्मीद जताई कि पश्चिम एशिया में जल्द शांति और सामान्य स्थिति बहाल होगी. भारत का कहना है कि क्षेत्र में बढ़ते तनाव को रोकने के लिए हमलों का तत्काल बंद होना जरूरी है.

title: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: ‘मेहंदी लगा के रखना…’ बेटी की शादी में अनंत सिंह की...
description: पटना के नदवां गांव में शिवांगी सिंह की शादी के लिए करीब 10 बीघा जमीन पर भव्य पंडाल बनाया गया है. बिहटा के कृष्णानगर से दूल्हा ऋषिकेश कुमार बरात लेकर पहुंचेंगे.
author: TV9 Bharatvarsh
content:
Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: ‘मेहंदी लगा के रखना…’ बेटी की शादी में अनंत सिंह की पत्नी ने किया डांस, VIDEO वायरल
पटना के नदवां गांव में शिवांगी सिंह की शादी के लिए करीब 10 बीघा जमीन पर भव्य पंडाल बनाया गया है. बिहटा के कृष्णानगर से दूल्हा ऋषिकेश कुमार बरात लेकर पहुंचेंगे.
बिहार के मोकामा से विधायक अनंत सिंह की बेटी शिवांगी सिंह की शादी आज होने जा रही है. शादी समारोह की भव्य तैयारियों के बीच परिवार के जश्न का एक वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर खूब वायरल हो रहा है. वीडियो में अनंत सिंह की पत्नी नीलम देवी एक महिला डांसर के साथ झूमती दिख रही हैं. वहीं, दुल्हन शिवांगी और परिवार की बड़ी बेटी राजनंदनी इस पल को अपने मोबाइल में कैद करती दिखीं.
वायरल वीडियो में देखा जा सकता है कि एक महिला डांसर नीलम देवी से अपने साथ डांस करने का अनुरोध करती है. पहले तो नीलम देवी डांसर को देखती हैं, लेकिन बाद में वह भी उसके साथ थिरकने लगती हैं. इस दौरान शादी समारोह में मौजूद परिवार की अन्य महिलाएं और मेहमान भी जश्न में शामिल नजर आते हैं.
वीडियो में ‘मेहंदी लगा के रखना…’ गाने पर नीलम देवी डांसर के साथ नाचती दिखाई देती हैं. उनके इस अंदाज में देखकर वहां मौजूद लोग भी उत्साहित नजर आते हैं. वहीं, दुल्हन शिवांगी गोल्डन ड्रेस में बेहद आकर्षक लग रही थीं. उनके तीनों भाई और परिवार के अन्य सदस्य भी समारोह में मौजूद रहे.
यहां देखें Video
151 गाड़ियों के काफिले के साथ आज पहुंचेगी बरात
शिवांगी सिंह की शादी को यादगार बनाने के लिए पटना के नदवां गांव में बड़े स्तर पर तैयारियां की गई हैं. बिहटा के कृष्णानगर से ऋषिकेश कुमार दूल्हा बनकर बरात लेकर नदवां गांव पहुंचेंगे. बरात में 151 गाड़ियों का काफिला शामिल होने की तैयारी है. शादी वैदिक रीति-रिवाज से संपन्न होगी.
इस आयोजन के लिए नदवां गांव में करीब 10 बीघा जमीन पर भव्य पंडाल तैयार कराया गया है. मेहमानों के लिए सुबह 10 बजे से ही भोजन की व्यवस्था शुरू करने की तैयारी है. शादी में लाखों लोगों के पहुंचने की संभावना को देखते हुए व्यापक इंतजाम किए गए हैं. समारोह में पंजाब से आई महिलाओं ने भी डांस किया. इसके अलावा कलाकारों की प्रस्तुतियों ने जश्न का माहौल और खुशनुमा बना दिया.
शादी समारोह में मेहमानों के मनोरंजन के लिए कई खास आयोजन रखे गए हैं. इनमें घुड़दौड़ भी प्रमुख आकर्षण है. बुधवार दोपहर दो बजे से घुड़दौड़ प्रतियोगिता शुरू होने की बात कही जा रही है. इसमें हिस्सा लेने के लिए दूसरे राज्यों से भी घोड़े मंगाए गए हैं.

title: 350 करोड़ रिकॉर्ड लीक, यूजरनेम-पासवर्ड से लेकर सरकारी ID तक खतरे में, दो बड़े डेटा लीक का हुआ खुलासा
description: दुनियाभर में साइबर सुरक्षा को लेकर एक बार फिर चिंता बढ़ गई है. साइबर सिक्योरिटी रिसर्चर्स ने डेटा लीक के दो बड़े मामलों का पता लगाया है, जिनमें 3.5 अरब से ज्यादा रिकॉर्ड सामने आ गए हैं.
author: उद् भव त्रिपाठी
content:
350 करोड़ रिकॉर्ड लीक, यूजरनेम-पासवर्ड से लेकर सरकारी ID तक खतरे में, दो बड़े डेटा लीक का हुआ खुलासा
दुनियाभर में साइबर सुरक्षा को लेकर एक बार फिर चिंता बढ़ गई है. साइबर सिक्योरिटी रिसर्चर्स ने डेटा लीक के दो बड़े मामलों का पता लगाया है, जिनमें 3.5 अरब से ज्यादा रिकॉर्ड सामने आ गए हैं.
3 मुख्य बातें
- दो बड़े डेटा लीक में 3.5 अरब से ज्यादा रिकॉर्ड लीक.
- लीक डेटा में ईमेल, पासवर्ड, फोन नंबर और सरकारी ID शामिल हैं.
- चोरी की जानकारी से ऑनलाइन ठगी और पहचान की नकल का खतरा बढ़ा.
दुनियाभर में डेटा की सुरक्षा को लेकर एक बार फिर से बड़ी चिंता सामने आई है. साइबर सिक्योरिटी रिसर्चर्स ने डेटा लीक के दो बड़े मामलों का हैरान कर देने वाला खुलासा किया है. रिसर्चर्स के इन दोनों मामलों में कुल 3.5 अरब से ज्यादा रिकॉर्ड सामने आए हैं. लीक हुई डिटेल्स में ईमेल आईडी, यूजरनेम, पासवर्ड, फोन नंबर, सरकारी पहचान संख्या और पर्सनल डॉक्यूमेंट्स शामिल हैं. रिपोर्ट के अनुसार एक डेटाबेस में लगभग 2 अरब लॉगिन रिकॉर्ड सामने आए हैं, वहीं दूसरे में चीन से जुड़े 1.64 अरब रिकॉर्ड मौजूद हैं. एक्सपर्ट्स ने इसको लेकर चेतावनी जारी की है कि इस जानकारी का इस्तेमाल साइबर अपराधी अकाउंट में सेंध लगाने, पहचान की नकल करने और ऑनलाइन फॉर्ड जैसे कामों के लिए कर सकते हैं.
वायर्ड की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार इन दोनों मामलों का पता अलग-अलग साइबर सिक्योरिटी रिसर्चर्स ने लगाया है. इनमें से एक डेटाबेस में चीन से जुड़े 1.64 अरब रिकॉर्ड मिले हैं, वहीं लगभग 2 अरब लॉगिन दूसरे देशों के रिकॉर्ड मौजूद थे. लेकिन यहां ध्यान देने वाली बात यह है कि 3.5 अरब का डेटा का रिकॉर्ड की संख्या है, प्रभावित लोगों की नहीं. इसकी वजह यह है कि एक ही व्यक्ति की जानकारी कई अकाउंट में दर्ज हो सकती है.
मालवेयर के जरिए चुराए गए 2 अरब रिकॉर्ड
पहले मामले का पता Black Hills Information Security के रिसर्चर्स जेरेमिया फाउलर ने लगाया है. उन्हें एक ऐसा डेटाबेस मिला, जिसमें लगभग 2 अरब लॉगिन रिकॉर्ड मौजूद थे. इसमें ईमेल एड्रेस, पासवर्ड, यूजरनेम, कुकीज, सेशन टोकन और डिवाइस से जुड़ी डिटेल्स शामिल थीं. यह डेटा 8,471 अलग-अलग फोल्डर में देश के हिसाब से रखा गया था.
रिसर्चर्स के अनुसार इस जानकारी का बड़ा हिस्सा इन्फो स्टीलर मालवेयर के जरिए जुटाया गया हो सकता है. इस तरह का मालवेयर किसी डिवाइस में मौजूद सेव पासवर्ड और दूसरी पर्सनल डिटेल्स चुरा सकता है. इसके बाद साइबर अपराधी इस डेटा को खरीदने और बेचने का काम करते हैं. इस मामले में सबसे ज्यादा चिंता की बात लगभग 4 लाख डॉक्यूमेंट्स का मिलना है. फाउलर के अनुसार ये डॉक्यूमेंट्स किसी ज्यादा ज्यादा एडवांस मालवेयर से जुटाए गए हो सकते हैं. इनके जरिए किसी व्यक्ति की डिजिटल एक्टिविटी और पर्सनल जानकारी की प्रोफाइल तैयार की जा सकती है.
चीन से जुड़े 1.64 अरब रिकॉर्ड भी सामने आए
दूसरे मामले का पता साइबर सिक्योरिटी कंपनी UpGuard के रिसर्च डायरेक्टर ग्रेग पोलॉक ने लगाया. उन्हें 1.64 अरब डॉक्यूमेंट्स वाला एक डेटाबेस मिला, जिसका संबंध मुख्य रूप से चीन के लोगों और वहां के बिजनेस से जुड़ा था. इसमें लगभग 84 करोड़ अलग-अलग राष्ट्रीय पहचान संख्या, 30 करोड़ फोन नंबर, 1.1 करोड़ स्टूडेंट एनरोलमेंट रिकॉर्ड और करीब 80 लाख बिजनेस रजिस्ट्रेशन की जानकारी शामिल थी. कुछ रिकॉर्ड में बच्चों और मृत लोगों की डिटेल्स भी मिली.
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक इस डेटाबेस को बिना किसी पासवर्ड या पहचान की पुष्टि के एक्सेस किया जा सकता था. लेकिन जांच के दौरान यह डेटाबेस अचानक मिलना बंद हो गया. इसके पीछे रैनसमवेयर हमले या किसी दूसरी साइबर एक्टिविटी की चिंता जताई गई है.
रिसर्चर्स का कहना है कि अलग-अलग जगहों से जुटाई गई ऐसी जानकारियां साइबर अपराधियों के लिए काफी मददगार हो सकती हैं. इनका इस्तेमाल फेक पहचान बनाने, अकाउंट में सेंध लगाने और लोगों को निशाना बनाकर ठगी करने में किया जा सकता है. बता दें कि साल 2024 में सामने आए मदर ऑफ ऑल ब्रीचेज मामले में 26 अरब रिकॉर्ड उजागर हुए थे, जिसे अब तक के सबसे बड़े डेटा लीक मामलों में गिना जाता है.

title: 4-Member Panel To Probe Sexual Harassment Complaint Against TVK MLA
description: The constitution of the committee comes hours after the High Court directed the state government to constitute an ICC and submit its report by November 27.
author: J Sam Daniel Stalin
content:
The Tamil Nadu government has constituted a four-member Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) to investigate a sexual harassment complaint filed by a woman bureaucrat against TVK MLA C Arul Vignesh, following a direction from the Madras High Court on Tuesday.
Senior IAS officer Kakarla Usha, Secretary to the Tamil Nadu Environment Department, will head the committee as its Presiding Officer. The three other members are Madhumathi, an IAS officer who serves as Secretary of the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department, Sumathi, a government officer, and Sunitha Joe, a social worker.
The constitution of the committee comes hours after the High Court directed the state government to constitute an ICC and submit its report by November 27.
The court took note of the peculiar difficulty faced by the complainant, who was herself the District Officer under the POSH Act and headed the district-level committee tasked with addressing sexual harassment complaints. This meant she could not approach the very committee under her own charge with a complaint against the MLA. The court therefore directed the constitution of a state-level ICC to examine her complaint.
During the hearing, the court made strong observations about the seriousness of sexual harassment complaints, remarking that it was a "sad day for the republic". It also observed: "If this is the situation for a Collector, what about women in lesser posts?"
In a parallel move, the government has appointed SP Shristi Singh as the Investigating Officer in the police case, with Inspector General of Police N Kamini designated as the Monitoring Officer.
The High Court has also imposed restrictions on media coverage of the case. Invoking Section 16 of the POSH Act, the court restrained the press and media from publishing or communicating information covered by the provision, which mandates confidentiality regarding the identities of the complainant, respondent and witnesses, as well as the complaint and inquiry proceedings.
The Cyber Crime Department has been directed to remove existing social media posts containing such information. Social media platforms and intermediaries have also been asked to prevent further publication. The court warned that violations could invite prosecution.
The FIR followed a complaint lodged on November 23 over allegations that the MLA had sent sexually coloured and obscene WhatsApp messages to the woman bureaucrat and had allegedly visited her residence in an inebriated condition. Arul Vignesh has denied the allegations, describing them as baseless and politically motivated.
The ICC is expected to examine the complaint and submit its findings within the timeline stipulated by the High Court.

title: IAS Harjot Kaur Bamhrah Appointed BPSC Chairperson; Earlier Made Headlines Over Sanitary Pad Remark
description: Harjot Kaur Bamhrah made headlines in 2022 due to a statement she made during an interaction with ninth and tenth-grade students.
author: Rajnish Kumar Singh, Aakanksha Singh
content:
BPSC Chairperson: Harjot Kaur Bamhrah, a 1992-batch IAS officer who previously held the responsibility for the Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) as an additional charge, has now been appointed as the new Chairperson of the Commission. The Governor of Bihar has made this appointment under Article 316 of the Constitution of India. She will assume the role of Chairperson effective November 29, 2026. Prior to this, she had been entrusted with the additional charge of the BPSC Chairperson following the departure of the then-Chairperson, Parmar Ravi Manubhai, on leave.
According to the issued notification, Harjot Kaur Bamhrah will take voluntary retirement (VRS) on November 28, 2026. Her appointment will come into effect the following day, November 29. It is noteworthy that while she was originally scheduled to retire on May 31, 2027, she applied for voluntary retirement ahead of that date.
Tenure
In accordance with Article 316(2) of the Constitution, her tenure as the BPSC Chairperson will last for six years or until she reaches the age of 62, whichever comes first.
1992-Batch IAS Officer Of Bihar Cadre
Bamhrah is a 1992-batch IAS officer of the Bihar cadre. Originally from Maharashtra, she was born in 1967. She holds an MPhil in International Studies from Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi. Additionally, she has earned a postgraduate diploma in International Law and a Master's degree in International Business from Duke University in the United States. She also holds master's degrees in Political Science and Industrial Development.
Key Responsibilities, Administrative Service Recap
Throughout her administrative career, Bamhrah has served in various significant positions in Bihar. She has held roles such as Additional Chief Secretary, Chief Advisor, Secretary, Managing Director, Director, Chief Vigilance Officer, and District Collector and Magistrate. She has also served as the Managing Director (MD) of the Women and Child Development Corporation.
Made Headlines For Her Remarks On Sanitary Pads
Harjot Kaur Bamhrah made headlines in 2022 due to a statement she made. During an interaction with ninth and tenth-grade students at the 'Sashakt Beti, Samriddh Bihar' (Empowered Daughter, Prosperous Bihar) event in Patna, a student asked her: if the government provides uniforms and scholarships, why cannot it also provide sanitary pads, which cost 20-30 rupees, for free?
In response, Harjot Kaur remarked that if the government were to provide sanitary pads, there would soon be demands for free jeans, trousers, and shoes as well. Alluding to family planning, she further added that, by that logic, the government would eventually have to provide contraceptives for free too. Her statement sparked significant controversy and drew widespread criticism. She later expressed regret over her remarks.

title: Why Samajwadi Party Announced 5 Candidates Amid UP Seat-Sharing Talks
description: The Samajwadi Party's surprise announcement came in the middle of alliance negotiations in Delhi. It drew a strong response from sections of the UP Congress unit and exposed friction over who sits at the negotiating table
author: Debanish Achom
content:
The Samajwadi Party was forced to unilaterally announce its first list of five candidates for the Uttar Pradesh assembly elections to counter "vocal" Congress leaders who were disrupting seat-sharing negotiations through public remarks, sources in the Samajwadi Party told NDTV today.
The Samajwadi Party's surprise announcement came in the middle of alliance negotiations in Delhi. It drew a strong response from sections of the UP Congress unit and exposed friction over who sits at the negotiating table.
The Congress leadership failed to rein in its outspoken state leaders and instead emboldened them by inducting them directly into the formal coordination panel, sources in the party led by Akhilesh Yadav said.
The Samajwadi Party fielded its most senior and pragmatic veterans for the talks, but the Congress did not pick constructive negotiators, they said, adding that several Congress leaders deliberately made provocative statements in the media to derail the alliance talks.
By naming its candidates first, the Samajwadi Party wanted to show its ground preparedness as well as its firm stance to the Congress, which is a partner in the opposition bloc INDIA.
During the ongoing talks, the Congress sought to fight in a large number of seats without actually giving specific candidate names, sources said.
The Samajwadi Party's unilateral move was strongly criticised by UP Congress leader Imran Masood, after which the party's leadership acted fast to soften its stand and deal with the flare-up.
"If Samajwadi Party has released their candidate list, then that is their own internal matter. However, given that the top leadership and the designated negotiators from both parties are in active dialogue, it is clear that this alliance is set to send a very positive message," Congress MP Ujjwal Raman Singh said, downplaying the rift.
Masood is believed to be upset because one of the five seats in the list is Saharanpur, which falls within his own Lok Sabha constituency.
"We aren't begging. The deal has to be mutually acceptable, respectable," he said, adding that he would speak with the Congress's central leadership on whether they should even remain at the negotiating table.
"When you are holding talks on one hand and making announcements on the other, it shows that you are not serious. We will discuss within our party what needs to be done and whether we should sit for talks or not. The party will decide what course of action to take," Masood added.
The friction surfaced on the third day of the seat-sharing talks held in Delhi. So far, the Samajwadi Party had offered 26 assembly seats, way short of the Congress's expectations of over 60 seats.
Akhilesh Yadav in a post on X said that fielding nominees as "PDA (Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak) candidates" was the best approach. Another Samajwadi Party leader, Udai Veer Singh, said the party had primarily announced candidates on seats it already won in the 2022 assembly polls.
"The practice is the same as it was during 2024 Lok Sabha polls when the party kept making gradual announcements amid seat-sharing talks. The arrangement was successful then, wasn't it?" Singh asked.
Of the five constituencies, four are in western UP and are held by Ashu Malik in Saharanpur, Nahid Hasan in Kairana, Umar Ali Khan in Behat and Mehboob Ali in Amroha.

title: Battle Of Two Babas: What's Behind Ramdev Versus Dhirendra Shastri?
description: Why Ramdev chose to publicly criticise Shastri soon after attending his much-publicised and well-attended Ram Katha in Uttar Pradesh for an earlier comment remains an interesting question.
author: Mohd Asim
content:
Battle Of Two Babas: What's Behind Ramdev Versus Dhirendra Shastri?
Why Ramdev chose to publicly criticise Shastri soon after attending his much-publicised and well-attended Ram Katha in Uttar Pradesh for an earlier comment remains an interesting question.                        
At the Kunda Ram Katha, there was warmth. Within days, there was fire. The bonhomie gave way to a sharp exchange of words, putting yoga guru Baba Ramdev and Bageshwar Dham's Dhirendra Krishna Shastri at the centre of a controversy that has spilled beyond the religious sphere into politics.
The trigger was a set of remarks attributed to Dhirendra Shastri about Lord Ram and Lord Krishna. A viral clip purportedly showed him comparing the two deities, describing Lord Ram as seedhe (straight) and Lord Krishna as tedhe-medhe (crooked), an apparent reference to Krishna's traditional tribhanga (three-bend) posture. The remarks triggered criticism from several quarters, with demands for an apology.
Dhirendra Shastri later apologised for his comments on Lord Krishna, describing them as an "emotional outburst" and reiterating that he was a devotee of Krishna.
Ramdev, who had shared a stage with Shastri just days earlier, was particularly scathing in his response. Shastri's comments were from an earlier katha. Why Ramdev chose to publicly criticise Shastri soon after attending his much-publicised and well-attended Ram Katha in Uttar Pradesh for an earlier comment remains an interesting question.
Speaking in Jamshedpur, the yoga guru took exception to the Ram-Krishna comparison, minced no words and called Shastri a pakhandi (hypocrite).
"Those who made comparisons between Gods and Goddesses - 'Ram mahan hain, Krishna toh tedhe-medhe hain' - later apologised and bowed before Banke Bihari. What did they say later? 'Krishna toh tedhe hi hain.' You have lost it. Pakhandi (hypocrite)," Ramdev said.
He went on to assert that nobody had the right to make such casual remarks about deities. "There is decorum, discipline and protocol for everything," he said.
The criticism was notable not just for its sharpness but also because it came from someone who had publicly embraced Shastri just days earlier.
The Kunda gathering itself had attracted considerable attention, with prominent Thakur leaders and political figures in attendance. Ramdev's presence alongside Shastri was another indication of the latter's growing reach among influential religious and political circles.
Thirty-year-old Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, head priest of Bageshwar Dham in Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, and popularly known as "Bageshwar Baba", has gained massive popularity in India and abroad through his religious discourses (kathas), claims of supernatural insight through what is popularly known as parcha writing, and his high-energy public speaking style.
Ramdev, a hugely popular yoga guru and considerably older than Shastri, has built a massive following through his yoga camps and the Patanjali business empire.
After The Rebuke Came Reconciliation
The climbdown was almost as swift as the outburst. At a press conference in Haridwar on November 24, Ramdev said he had spoken to Shastri a day earlier and had "reprimanded him out of affection".
"Bageshwar Baba is like a child in front of me. He is also like my younger brother and disciple. Therefore, the things that seemed inappropriate to me and caused me pain, I reprimanded him with my authority. He too accepted my scolding as love. This is also his greatness," Ramdev said.
Ramdev also sought to place the controversy within a broader debate about religious practices, insisting that Sanatan Dharma should not be associated with superstition or hypocrisy.
"Sanatan Dharma is divine. Sanatan Dharma is scientific. The values of Sanatan Dharma are very high," he said, adding that his remarks had been misinterpreted and that the issue had been unnecessarily amplified on social media.
Shastri's Response: Criticism Is Also A Blessing
Shastri, too, chose to play down the controversy rather than respond to Ramdev's outburst in kind. Instead, he presented the criticism as an expression of affection from an elder and guardian.
Speaking during a katha in Pathankot, he said: "Ramdev ji is very simple. He is a great man. He is our own. There is great joy between both of us. If something was in his mind, he gave a blessing. This too is a blessing. A good blessing."
Pointing out that Ramdev had praised him just days before criticising him, Shastri said he was equally comfortable with both.
"I am happy with both. He is a revered swami. He is a guru. He can say whatever he wants with love," he said.
In another statement, Shastri described Ramdev as a mahapurush and reiterated that he regarded him as a guardian. He also said he had no intention of reacting to the criticism.
"We accept his criticism as well as his praise. We cannot have any feeling of disregard towards saints. We aim to unite Hindu society, not to divide it," he said.
The responses from both sides have effectively sought to contain the disagreement within the framework of a guru-disciple relationship. Yet the public nature of the exchange, and the political reactions it has generated, have ensured that it is being viewed as more than a personal disagreement.
Two Babas, Political Proximity
There is another reason the episode has attracted political attention. Both Ramdev and Shastri have, in different ways, been associated with the BJP's larger political and cultural ecosystem.
Ramdev's association with the BJP and Prime Minister Narendra Modi is long-standing. The yoga guru was among the prominent public figures who campaigned against corruption and the Congress-led UPA government ahead of the 2014 Lok Sabha election and later endorsed the BJP and PM Modi.
Shastri, meanwhile, has developed a high-profile public association with the BJP leadership. Prime Minister Modi has publicly referred to him as his "brother". His kathas, which frequently focus on uniting Hindus and protecting Sanatan Dharma, also resonate with the BJP's broader political messaging.
The two spiritual figures, however, occupy somewhat different public spaces. Ramdev's influence has grown through yoga, Patanjali and his interventions in public and political debates. Shastri's popularity, on the other hand, is rooted in his kathas, religious outreach and a large following, particularly among younger audiences.
Akhilesh Yadav Sees An Opportunity
The disagreement has also provided the Opposition with an opportunity to take a swipe at the BJP and religious figures perceived to be close to it.
अनुलोम-विलोम https://t.co/O0pQMRu1yc
— Akhilesh Yadav (@yadavakhilesh) November 23, 2026
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav took a potshot at the exchange, using the war of words between the two babas to target the political establishment.
His party had earlier opposed Shastri's katha in Uttar Pradesh over his reported comments on Lord Krishna. The Yadav community, also referred to as Yaduvanshis, traces its lineage to Lord Krishna.
For the Opposition, the episode offers an opportunity to question the conduct of prominent religious figures and the political ecosystem in which they operate. For the BJP, the challenge is to avoid being drawn into a controversy that began with comments about Hindu deities but has acquired a political life of its own.
This is particularly significant at a time when the BJP is seeking to make the proposed grand temple at Krishna Janmabhoomi in Mathura a prominent part of its political messaging ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly election.
The two babas have now sought to put a lid on their disagreement.
But the episode has exposed an interesting contradiction: two figures who share public platforms, command considerable influence among sections of Hindu society and are seen as having close links with the BJP have found themselves on opposite sides of a debate over how Hindu deities should be spoken about.

title: 43 Fall Ill After Eating Chicken Shawarma In Maharashtra
description: Another patient, who also reported falling sick after eating shawarma from Vanjar Patti Naka, said the symptoms had persisted since then.
author: Indo Asian News Service
content:
At least 53 people, including 17 children, fell ill due to suspected food poisoning after consuming chicken shawarma purchased from a roadside stall near Vanjar Patti Naka in Maharashtra's Bhiwandi, officials said.
The affected individuals include people ranging in age from a two-year-old child to adults aged up to 40 years. A pregnant woman is also among those admitted to the hospital following the incident.
According to the information, the total number of people affected has reached 53, comprising 11 men, 25 women and 17 children. Several of them reportedly developed symptoms such as vomiting, diarrhoea and fever after consuming the shawarma.
Those experiencing health complications have been admitted to the Indira Gandhi Memorial (IGM) Sub-District Hospital in Bhiwandi, where they are currently receiving medical treatment.
The incident has raised concerns after several people who reportedly ate food purchased from the same stall fell ill within a short period.

— IANS (@ians_india) November 25, 2026
One of the patients, speaking to IANS, recounted falling sick a day after eating shawarma from the stall.
Describing the difficulties faced after consuming the food, the patient said, "I ate shawarma on Monday, and the next day I fell ill. I remained sick throughout the day and was unable to even stand up. Following this, I was admitted to the hospital. After coming here, I came to know that several other people had also fallen ill after eating shawarma."
Another patient, who also reported falling sick after eating shawarma from Vanjar Patti Naka, said the symptoms had persisted since then.
"I had shawarma from Vanjar Patti Naka, and I have been sick ever since. I have been vomiting continuously since then. There are many patients admitted here, and all of them are suffering from food poisoning," the patient told IANS.
Another person, whose brother was admitted to the hospital after falling ill, said the family learnt about the larger outbreak only after reaching the medical facility.
"My brother is here. He suffered food poisoning after eating shawarma. When we came here, we got to know that many other people who had eaten shawarma had also fallen ill," the person said.
The affected patients are currently undergoing treatment at the IGM Sub-District Hospital.

title: Who Is Justice GR Swaminathan, Judge At Centre Of Tamil Nadu Deepam Row?
description: On December 1, 2025, Justice Swaminathan, who is a part of the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, directed that the Deepam be lit at the hilltop pillar, in addition to the customary location near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple.
author: Manjiri Chitre
content:
Justice GR Swaminathan is back in focus at the centre of the Deepam row in Tamil Nadu as the state government lit the Karthigai Deepam at the traditional location near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple on the Thiruparankundram hill in Madurai, instead of the hilltop stone pillar next to a Dargah.
Earlier on Tuesday, the Madurai bench of the Madras High Court, headed by Justice Swaminathan and Sumathi, directed the district administration to carry out the Supreme Court's interim order to light the Karthigai Deepam at the pillar on Thiruparankundram hill.
Who is Justice GR Swaminathan?
Born in 1968, Justice GR Swaminathan is a first-generation lawyer who earned his law degree in 1990 and enrolled as an advocate in 1991. He practised for over 13 years in Chennai and also served as the standing counsel for many public sector undertakings.
In 2014, Justice Swaminathan became the Assistant Solicitor General of India for the Madurai Bench.
In 2017, he was appointed an additional judge of the Madras High Court and later made permanent.
During his career, Justice Swaminathan gave many landmark judgments, including on prisoners' rights, animal rights, and free speech.
In 2019, in an unusual move, Justice Swaminathan presented a self-appraisal card to the Bar on the completion of two years of judicial service. The card highlighted his achievements and sought the cooperation of lawyers in providing better service to litigants. It also mentioned that the judge had disposed of 18,944 cases individually and 2,534 cases as part of various benches since his appointment to the High Court.
Justice Swaminathan is due to retire from service in May 2030.
Justice Swaminathan on Deepam row
On December 1, 2025, Justice Swaminathan, who is a part of the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, directed that the Deepam be lit at the hilltop pillar, in addition to the customary location near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple, triggering a political storm. The order was not implemented after the authorities cited possible law and order concerns.
Subsequently, over 100 INDIA bloc MPs moved an impeachment against him, accusing the judge of what they called "proven misbehaviour and gross misconduct."
The MPs accused Justice Swaminathan of selectively prioritising cases, saying he prioritised listings and time slots for a specific group of advocates, particularly from the Brahmin community and those aligned with right-wing ideologies.
They also alleged "preferential treatment" to Senior Advocate M Sricharan Rangarajan between April and July 2024, claiming urgent matters were bypassed to accommodate him.
In January this year, Justice Swaminathan lit a lamp resembling the 'Deepathoon' at an event in Chennai.
The Deepam row
The dispute centered on whether the Karthigai Deepam should also be lit at a stone pillar on the summit of the Thiruparankundram hill, close to a Dargah.
The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, in its December 1, 2025 judgment, directed that the Deepam be lit at the hilltop pillar, in addition to the customary location near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple. The court held that the hill belonged to the temple, except for the areas occupied by the Dargah, the steps leading to it, and the Nellithope area. It also accepted the petitioners' claim that the pillar was meant for lighting lamps.
The state government, then under the DMK, did not implement the direction, citing law-and-order concerns. It argued that the established tradition was to light the Deepam near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple, a practice it said had continued for more than a century. The DMK government then contended that the court could not dictate where a religious lamp should be lit, as the decision should be guided by religious and Agama practices.
For decades, the Deepam continued to be lit at the traditional location near the Uchi Pillaiyar temple. Last year's judgment went further by specifically identifying the hilltop stone pillar, which the petitioners described as a Deepathoon, as an additional location for lighting the lamp.
The Madras High Court's direction was subsequently upheld in the legal proceedings before the Supreme Court.
In its interim order on November 20, the Supreme Court permitted a one-time lighting of the Deepam at the hilltop pillar on November 24. The permission was limited to that occasion and did not establish any permanent customary, religious or proprietary right. The customary observance near Uchi Pillaiyar was not displaced.
The Tamil Nadu government subsequently filed a review petition seeking reconsideration of the Supreme Court's order.

title: Assam IPS Officers' Late-Night Party Ends In Physical Fight, Cop Injured
description: Although the Assam Police headquarters has not issued an official statement on the incident, Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma acknowledged it on Tuesday and described it as a private matter.
author: Ratnadip Choudhury
content:
A gathering of senior police officers in Assam's Kokrajhar district reportedly turn violent after two IPS officers allegedly got into a physical confrontation following an argument.
The incident reportedly involved Kokrajhar Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Akshat Garg and Deputy Inspector General (DIG) YT Getsu. According to sources, a disagreement between the two officers escalated into a physical altercation, leaving Garg with multiple injuries.
The gathering was reportedly held on the premises of the 7th Assam Police Battalion at Saraikhola, with Garg hosting the party.
Although the Assam Police headquarters has not issued an official statement on the incident, Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma acknowledged it on Tuesday and described it as a private matter.
"This happened at a private party and the officers were not on duty. This was a personal matter and since they were not on duty, we cannot say anything," Sarma said.
The Chief Minister added that the government would have intervened had the confrontation taken place while the officers were performing their duties.
"If this had happened when they were on duty, we would have intervened and taken necessary steps," he said.
Sources said the Assam Director General of Police (DGP) had asked senior IPS officer Surendra Kumar to step in and help resolve the dispute between the two officers.
There has been no official confirmation of the circumstances that led to the alleged confrontation. Details of the injuries sustained by Garg and whether the matter will lead to any formal departmental action are also not known.
Advice To Newly Recruited Police Personnel
The reported incident comes on the same day Sarma addressed newly recruited Assam Police personnel at a passing-out parade at the Lachit Borphukan Police Academy in Dergaon.
Speaking to the recruits, the Chief Minister stressed discipline and professional conduct, asking them to stay away from intoxicating substances and avoid abusive or inappropriate language.
He said police personnel must ensure that their words, behaviour and actions uphold the dignity and responsibility associated with wearing the uniform.
